preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is at least 3 and at most 10^5.
The number of edges in the graph is at least 2 and at most 10^5.
Each node in the graph is connected to at least 2 and at most n - 1 other nodes.
The nodes in each edge are within the range from 1 to n.
There are no self-loops in the graph.

postconditions.description: The length of the found cycle is at least k + 1.

postconditions.expression: all(v_i != v_j for i < j in range(r))
postconditions.description: All nodes in the cycle are distinct.
The first and last nodes in the cycle are connected by an edge.

postconditions.expression: all(v_i and v_i+1 are connected by an edge for i in range(r-1))
postconditions.description: Each pair of consecutive nodes in the cycle are connected by an edge.
